description: Free and without quota: every crop or land-use code that can appear as crop_code (Spanish Catastro codes, the foral codes of Alava, Bizkaia, Gipuzkoa and Navarre, and the Austrian, Estonian and Greek catalogues) with its name in the requested language, the original label and its common use_class. Use it to translate or group crop codes; pass code to look one up.

code.description: Return only this crop code (e.g. G-, NA:1501, AT:53)

source.description: Return only codes of this catalogue: ES, AL, BI, GI, NA, AT, EE or GR
